reader.requirement: At --std 85 an OPEN naming several file-names (in one or several OUTPUT/EXTEND groups, report files and other files alike) must behave as one separate OPEN per file-name in source order: each file gets its own mode and I-O status, a failure of one (with its USE procedure) comes before the next file's OPEN, and the same file named twice gives the second OPEN the already-open result.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility through FileConnector.SharingFacilityInEffect: Table 19 arbitration and its 61 exist only from 2002; at 85 sibling connectors release buffered records instead
DialectBehavior.CloseWithLockLocksFileConnector: what a CLOSE WITH LOCK locks (physical file at 85, connector from 2002)

reader.edition-search: Grepped BindOpen, EmitOpen and EmitOpenScope for EditionContext, DialectLevel, DialectBehavior and CobolVersion: none. The split into one BoundOpen per file-name (BoundImplicitSeries) is the same at every edition. The only edition reads on the path are in the runtime OPEN arbitration, and neither one changes the one-OPEN-per-file order.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f19_05 covers two groups, two files in one group, an OPTIONAL file and first-file-fails order with a USE procedure that ends the run. It does not cover a failing first file whose USE returns (the later files must still open), the same file named twice, or a report file mixed with a sequential file in one group

probes.printed: OPEN OUTPUT EXTEND 00 05 / CLOSE 00 00 / OPEN EXTEND 00 00 / OPEN OUTPUT 00 / USE RX 35 (identical to .out)

probes.expected: OPEN EXTEND RX OUTPUT RQ: RX fails first (35) while RQ is not yet opened (RQ-S still 99), then RQ opens (00); OPEN OUTPUT RQ RQ: the second OPEN finds RQ open (41); OPEN OUTPUT SQ RQ: both 00; OPEN EXTEND RQ RX: RQ opened before RX fails

reader.notes: BindOpen binds each file-name with its own group's mode and returns a BoundImplicitSeries of one-file BoundOpen statements in source order, and EmitOpen emits a separate open scope, status store and USE hook for each file. The probes show RX's USE procedure running before RQ is opened, and a duplicate file-name giving 41 on its second OPEN.

refuter.evidence: r17grp.cob (runs/r17grp-001, --std 85): OPEN OUTPUT R1 WITH NO REWIND R2 EXTEND R3 R5 OUTPUT R4 (a repeated OUTPUT group, NO REWIND on one file of a group, an absent OPTIONAL R3, an absent non-OPTIONAL R5) with a USE ON EXTEND that returns. Printed 'USE-EXTEND 1 S1=07 S2=00 S3=05 S4=99 S5=35 / A 07 00 05 00 35': R5's USE ran before R4 was opened (S4 still 99), then R4 opened; R1's 07 is the 1985 status for OPEN NO REWIND on a non-reel medium (ANSI_COBOL_1985.md line 15269). All four reports then wrote their files. OPEN EXTEND R5 R5 on the absent file ran the USE twice ('B 35 N=2'), each as its own failed OPEN. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.4.5.4 GR17 ... the text is in GR17'. Nothing found that the reader's split-per-file reading misses.
